card.name: Pointing to a table or section
card.fires_on: Small words like "in", "the" or "see" right before a reference to a table, section or full prescribing information, usually after "described", "see" or "recommendations in".

modes.label: described in
modes.description: The word "in" after "described" or "see Table 1", just before a table or section name.
modes.example: Reduce dose, withhold dose, or discontinue CYRAMZA to manage adverse reactions as described<< in>> Table 1 . Table 1:

modes.label: see the
modes.description: "the" or "see" leading into a pointer to another section or the full prescribing information.
modes.example: mg/10 mg 10 mg/10 mg 15 mg/10 mg 20 mg/10 mg See<< the>> full prescribing information for the recommended titration

card.writes: It pushes toward opening quotation marks, which is a weak fit with these cross-reference words, so the output effect is unclear.
card.plain: It fires on the little word just before a label says to look at another table or section.
